name: docker-in-docker
description: Run a Docker daemon inside Wolfi-based development containers using Wolfi packages.

dockerDashComposeVersion.description: Default version of Docker Compose (v2 or none).

azureDnsAutoDetection.description: Allow automatically setting the dockerd DNS server when the installation script detects it is running in Azure.

dockerDefaultAddressPool.description: Define default address pools for Docker networks. e.g. base=192.168.0.0/16,size=24

disableIptables.description: Disable iptables for the inner Docker daemon. Useful when nested Docker providers manage networking outside the container.

disableIp6tables.description: Disable ip6tables for the inner Docker daemon.

copyDockerConfig.description: Whether to copy Docker config.json from the host into the container.
